Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Internationalisation team builds the platform that helps Stripe products work naturally across languages and markets. We create and operate the infrastructure that enables Stripe teams to localize product interfaces, services, and written communications while delivering consistent, high-quality experiences to users around the world.

We work closely with our sister Localization team and its language experts, as well as with product and service engineering teams integrating localized content. Together, we combine engineering, automation, and linguistic expertise to help Stripe build products that feel native to each market.

What you’ll do

You will design, implement, and maintain Stripe’s internationalisation platform at scale, including the developer and user experiences around it. You’ll help teams continuously localize their products while improving the quality, speed, reliability, and efficiency of Stripe’s localization processes.

This role combines backend and platform engineering with emerging LLM technology. Depending on the project, you may build end-to-end functionality for internal customers, evolve production LLM systems, develop quality-evaluation capabilities, improve platform reliability and observability, or lead migrations from legacy localization infrastructure.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build internationalisation infrastructure that supports diverse content surfaces, including backend services, product interfaces, and written communications.
  • Integrate localization into Stripe’s software-development and content-production workflows, enabling teams to ship translated experiences continuously and safely.
  • Build and maintain integrations with translation-management systems, LLM services and external localization providers.
  • Evolve Stripe’s existing production LLM capabilities to improve translation quality, market relevance, turnaround time, and operational efficiency.
  • Develop automated quality checks and human-evaluation workflows that combine LLM-driven automation with expert linguistic judgment.
  • Maintain a high bar for reliability through effective testing, monitoring, alerting, and operational processes.
  • Own ambiguous, high-impact initiatives end to end—from research and experimentation through implementation, launch, measurement, and iteration.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand new languages can be learned on the job so our interview process is language agnostic)
  • Experience developing reliable infrastructure, platform, or backend-service solutions.
  • Strong product judgment and a commitment to building high-quality user and developer experiences.
  • Ability to own ambiguous work end to end and make progress through research, experimentation, and iteration.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building or operating production LLM or machine-learning systems.
  • Experience evaluating LLM output or combining automated systems with expert human review.
  • Familiarity with internationalisation, localization, translation, or content-management workflows.
  • Experience with CI/CD systems, developer platforms, or workflow infrastructure.
  • Backend engineering experience building services using programming languages such as Java, Ruby, or Go.
  • Experience building internal platforms that ultimately support customer-facing products.
descriptions.job-047wkfh:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s SMB and Commercial Sales organization helps ambitious businesses adopt Stripe’s financial infrastructure and accelerate their growth. The team is responsible for acquiring new users, expanding Stripe’s relationships with existing users, and building durable partnerships across a diverse and fast-moving market.

We’re looking for an experienced second-line sales leader to lead our SMB and Commercial business across Southern Europe. You will manage a team of sales managers and Account Executives, set the regional strategy, and be accountable for delivering sustainable growth across multiple countries, customer segments, and sales motions.

This is a highly visible leadership role requiring strong commercial judgment, operational discipline, and the ability to develop leaders. You will work closely with regional and global Sales leadership and cross-functional partners across Marketing, Partnerships, Product, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Deal Pricing, and Operations.

What you’ll do

As Head of Southern Europe, SMB & Commercial, you will own the strategy, performance, and development of a complex, multi-market sales organization. You will build and lead a high-performing leadership team, translate Stripe’s broader strategy into clear regional priorities, and create the operating environment required to deliver consistent results at scale.

You will combine strategic leadership with hands-on involvement in the business. You’ll help your managers raise the performance of their teams, engage directly in the region’s most important opportunities, and represent Southern Europe in regional and global planning.

Responsibilities

  • Own the overall strategy and commercial performance of Stripe’s SMB and Commercial business across Southern Europe.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of sales managers and Account Executives across multiple countries, segments, and sales motions.

  • Build a strong leadership bench by hiring exceptional managers, setting clear expectations, and creating development and succession plans.

  • Establish a clear regional vision and translate it into country, segment, and team-level plans with measurable outcomes.

  • Deliver ambitious revenue, acquisition, expansion, and activation goals while building a healthy and sustainable long-term business.

  • Create a rigorous operating cadence across forecasting, pipeline generation, territory planning, performance management, and business reviews.

  • Hold managers accountable for team performance while coaching them to diagnose challenges, make sound decisions, and lead independently.

  • Identify differences across Southern European markets and adapt coverage, capacity, and go-to-market strategies accordingly.

  •  Build executive relationships with strategic customers and prospects, stepping into critical opportunities and negotiations when leadership involvement can materially improve the outcome.

  • Improve sales productivity and effectiveness by identifying systemic opportunities across process, tooling, enablement, segmentation, and coverage.

  • Partner closely with Marketing, SDR, Product Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Partnerships, Deal Pricing, and Operations to deliver an integrated regional strategy.

  • Represent the needs of Southern European users and sales teams to Stripe’s regional and global leadership.

  • Provide clear, evidence-based forecasts and communicate business performance, risks, and opportunities to senior stakeholders.

  • Foster an inclusive, high-accountability culture in which managers and sellers can do the best work of their careers.

  • Serve as a senior leader for Stripe in Southern Europe, contributing beyond the immediate sales organization to the health and growth of the broader regional business.

Who you are

You are an experienced second-line sales leader who has successfully grown a complex business across multiple markets, teams, or customer segments. You know how to lead through managers rather than relying on direct intervention, while remaining close enough to customers and the field to make high-quality decisions.

You can move comfortably between long-term strategy and operational execution. You bring structure to ambiguity, communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, and build organizations that deliver both near-term results and durable growth.

Minimum requirements

  • 12+ years of relevant sales or commercial experience in technology, financial services, payments, or another fast-growing industry.

  • A proven track record as a second-line manager, with meaningful experience leading and developing sales managers as well as Account Executives.

  • Demonstrated success growing a complex business across multiple countries, customer segments, products, or sales motions.

  • Experience owning a significant regional or multi-market revenue target and delivering sustained performance against ambitious growth goals.

  • A strong record of building high-performing organizations, including hiring and developing leaders, managing performance, and creating succession plans.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate company strategy into clear regional priorities, operating plans, and measurable team goals.

  • Experience running a disciplined sales organization, including forecasting, pipeline management, capacity planning, territory design, and performance reviews.

  • Strong executive presence and a track record of building trusted relationships with senior customer and internal stakeholders.

  • Excellent commercial judgment, including the ability to evaluate complex opportunities, allocate resources, and balance short-term execution with long-term growth.

  • Experience leading through periods of rapid growth, organizational change, or significant ambiguity.

  • Ability to influence across a highly cross-functional and matrixed organization without relying solely on formal authority.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to identify patterns, challenge assumptions, and make informed decisions.

  • A commitment to building inclusive teams and creating a culture of high standards, continuous improvement, and shared accountability.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience leading SMB and Commercial sales teams with distinct coverage models, sales cycles, and customer needs.

  • Experience managing a geographically distributed organization across several Southern European markets.

  • Experience scaling a business through multiple phases of growth rather than inheriting a mature and stable organization.

  • A track record of successfully leading both new-business acquisition and existing-customer expansion motions.

  • Experience in payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, SaaS, or another technically complex industry.

About the position

We’re looking for compiler engineers to join a new ML Compilers Team at Jane Street. 

Machine learning is a critical pillar of our global business. Our ever-evolving trading environment serves as a unique, rapid-feedback platform for ML experimentation, allowing us to incorporate new ideas with relatively little friction. Our ML team is full of people with a shared love for the craft of software engineering, and for designing APIs and systems that are delightful to use.

ML compilers let us quickly turn research ideas and novel architectures into high-throughput training jobs and low-latency inference. To get the most out of our hardware resources and enable rapid model development and deployment, we are working to understand and improve the current ML compiler technologies and explore where it makes sense to build our own solutions. In this role, you would shape the development of our compiler stack.

If you’ve never thought about a career in finance, you’re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you’ll fit right in.

About you

The ideal candidate has worked on an ML compiler in the past, but non-ML compiler experience is also valuable. Experience with any part of the stack is fine, be it high-level ML frameworks (PyTorch, Jax, TensorFlow), graph compilers (Inductor, XLA, TVM) or kernel DSLs (Triton, Helion, cuTile). You should understand how all those pieces fit together even if you are unfamiliar with specific parts. 

Some other things you might be excited about are:

  • Optimisations in ML compilers: algebraic rewriting, materialise vs recompute tradeoffs and fusion, equality saturation, scheduling languages, loop-level optimisation, autotuning
  • ML compiler frontends: graph capture, symbolic and dynamic shapes, control flow, automatic differentiation
  • GPU kernel programming and architecture: Triton, cuTile, CuTeDSL, CUDA, compute and memory hierarchies, programming with tensor cores
  • Compiler concepts: static analysis, intermediate representations like SSA and CFGs, instruction selection
  • ML inference: CUDA Graphs, KV caching, batching
  • ML training: Tensor/Sequence/Expert/Pipeline Parallelism, FSDP, NCCL, activation checkpointing
  • GPU debugging and optimisation: CUDA-GDB, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute
  • Formal methods: proof assistants, automated theorem provers, agentic proof systems
  • Programming languages and DSL design: embedded DSLs, staging and metaprogramming, type systems, functional programming
  • Fluency in English is required

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com.

Who are we?

FalconX is a pioneering team of operators, investors, and builders committed to revolutionizing institutional access to the crypto markets. Operating at the intersection of traditional finance and  cutting-edge technology, FalconX addresses the industry's foremost challenges: Navigating the digital asset market can be complex and fragmented, with limited products and services that support trading strategies, structures, and liquidity found in conventional financial markets. As a comprehensive solution for all digital asset strategies from start to scale, FalconX operates as the connective tissue empowering clients with seamless navigation through the ever- evolving cryptocurrency landscape.

Position Summary

FalconX is seeking a Personal Account Dealing Senior Compliance Associate to join our team and help to manage the program governing employee trading and conflicts of interest across the firm. In this role, you will review and adjudicate personal trading pre-clearance requests, monitor employee holdings and transactions for policy breaches, and administer the systems that make this program run. You will work at the intersection of compliance, data, and market structure — operating vendor-based employee compliance tooling alongside FalconX's internal systems to identify conflicts, detect undisclosed activity, and ensure the firm meets its code of ethics and market abuse obligations across the jurisdictions in which we operate.

Because FalconX operates in digital assets, this role extends the traditional personal account dealing discipline into self-custody wallets, on-chain activity, and token holdings. This role requires equal parts investigative rigor, technical comfort, and absolute discretion, and offers a unique opportunity to shape personal trading practice at one of the leading institutional digital asset platforms.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Pre-Clearance Adjudication: Independently review, approve, deny, or escalate employee pre-clearance requests for personal securities and digital asset transactions, applying restricted list rules, blackout periods, holding period requirements, and conflict checks within committed turnaround times.
  • Breach Identification & Escalation: Investigate suspected breaches of the personal account dealing policy — trading in restricted names, front-running firm or client activity, breach of minimum holding periods, use of undisclosed accounts — and prepare clear investigative narratives with supporting evidence for escalation to the Compliance Manager.
  • Restricted & Watch List Maintenance: Assist with maintaining the firm's restricted and watch lists, ensuring names and tokens are added and released on the correct triggers, and that list changes propagate correctly into the pre-clearance rule set.
  • MNPI Coordination: Work with Legal, Corporate Development, and business heads to ensure that material non-public information — deal activity, upcoming listings, client mandates — is reflected in trading restrictions on a timely basis.
  • Gifts & Entertainment / Outside Business Activities: Review and disposition gifts and entertainment and OBA submissions against firm thresholds, identify aggregation and pattern concerns, and escalate submissions raising bribery, inducement, or client-conflict risk.

Regulatory Compliance & Audit Support

  • Regulatory Alignment: Maintain a deep, up-to-date understanding of the personal trading and conflicts requirements applicable to the firm's regulated entities and their equivalents across jurisdictions, together with digital-asset-specific guidance, ensuring the program's coverage remains fully compliant as the regulatory perimeter shifts.
  • Policy Contribution: Partner with the Compliance Manager to update the personal account dealing policy, code of ethics, review playbooks, and standard operating procedures as regulations, product lines, and market structures evolve — with particular focus on where existing policy language does not cleanly address digital asset activity.
  • Audit Readiness: Assemble pre-clearance records, breach files, attestation completion evidence, and decision rationale for internal audit, bank partner reviews, and regulatory examinations, ensuring each file stands on its own without verbal explanation.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Law, Data Science, or a related field.

Experience: 1–3 years of direct experience in personal account dealing, code of ethics, or employee compliance monitoring at a broker-dealer, asset manager, bank, proprietary trading firm, fintech, or digital asset platform. Experience running or administering a personal trading program — not solely submitting into one — is strongly preferred.

Platform Experience: Hands-on experience with STAR Compliance is strongly preferred, including administrator-level familiarity with pre-clearance rule configuration, broker and custodian data feeds, attestation campaigns, and reporting. Experience with comparable employee compliance platforms (ComplySci, MyComplianceOffice, Schwab Compliance Technologies) will be considered, provided the candidate has configured and maintained the system rather than only used its front end.

Analytical Mindset: Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to reconstruct what an employee actually traded from incomplete records, spot the account that was never disclosed, and distinguish a genuine oversight from a deliberate circumvention.

Discretion & Judgment: Proven ability to handle sensitive personal information about colleagues with complete confidentiality, and the composure to make and defend unpopular decisions — including denying a request from a senior stakeholder — without escalating unnecessarily or capitulating inappropriately.

Communication: Crisp verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document decisions clearly, explain a denial in terms an employee understands, and articulate personal trading expectations to non-compliance stakeholders across the firm.

Digital Asset Interest: Genuine interest in digital asset markets and the practical mechanics of self-custody, on-chain activity, staking, and airdrops — enough to reason about how a policy written for equities should apply to a wallet.

The base pay for this role is expected to be between $132,000 - $167,000 in the New York City Area. This expected base pay range is based on information at the time this post was generated. This role will also be eligible for other forms of compensation such as a performance linked bonus, equity, and a competitive benefits package. Actual compensation for a successful candidate will be determined based on a number of factors such as location, skillset, experience, qualifications and the level at which the candidate is hired.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data scientists and data analysts learn and grow together. The Treasury Finance Data Science team builds the models, risk frameworks, and decision tools behind how Stripe manages money at global scale: liquidity, funding, counterparty risk, and foreign exchange.

Stripe moves funds across 135+ currencies every day. That creates FX exposure from merchant flows, multi-currency balances, and entity funding. In this role, you'll be a thought partner and builder alongside Stripe's FX team. Together you'll develop the quantitative foundation for how Stripe measures, forecasts, and hedges FX exposure.

What you'll do

You'll be the senior quantitative lead for FX within Treasury Finance Data Science. You'll co-build with Treasury, the FX hedging team, Finance, and Engineering: shaping the research agenda, turning ideas into rigorous models, and building the systems that put those models to work. Data Science owns these systems. They produce the decision-critical outputs and analyses that the FX team and Treasury leadership rely on. This is a hands-on role. You'll design the methodology, write the code, and ship it into production.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with the FX team to build and evolve FX risk measurement: exposure aggregation across entities and currencies, VaR / Expected Shortfall, stress testing, and scenario analysis
  • Develop forecasting models for FX exposures and multi-currency cash flows. Quantify forecast uncertainty so it can inform hedge sizing and timing.
  • Co-design hedge optimization and decision frameworks with the FX team that weigh hedge cost, residual risk, P&L volatility, and liquidity constraints
  • Build ML and statistical systems for trading and risk (signal research, anomaly detection on flows, execution and cost analytics), and take them from prototype to production
  • Own the production systems that generate decision-critical FX outputs, partnering with Engineering on reliability, SLAs, monitoring, alerting, and incident response for risk-critical workflows
  • Partner deeply with Treasury Finance stakeholders to turn business questions into quantitative frameworks. Anticipate needs and help shape FX risk strategy rather than reacting to requests.
  • Produce clear, trusted analyses and reporting that inform Treasury and Finance leadership decisions, including leadership-level reporting such as MBRs and QBRs
  • Use AI tools (code assistants, LLM-based agents) to speed up modeling, analysis, and automation, while maintaining rigor, validation, and auditability
  • Raise the technical bar for FX quantitative work within Data Science: methodology standards, model validation, documentation, and mentoring other data scientists

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • BS/BA with 8+ years, MS/MA with 6+ years, or PhD with 3+ years of full-time experience in quantitative finance, risk modeling, quantitative research, or data science
  • Hands-on quantitative experience at a bank, asset manager, hedge fund, trading firm, or similar financial institution, with direct exposure to FX, rates, or market risk
  • Strong foundation in statistics, probability, and time-series modeling, plus working knowledge of risk measures (VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress testing) and hedging instruments (forwards, swaps, options)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL. You write production-quality code, not just research scripts.
  • Experience taking models or analytical systems from research into production
  • Business acumen and the ability to turn complex analyses into clear, decision-ready insights
  • Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact with cross-functional partners, including senior non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at once, with strong attention to detail
  • Experience using AI tools to speed up modeling, analysis, and coding

Preferred qualifications

  • MS or PhD in a quantitative field (e.g., Quantitative / Mathematical Finance, Financial Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Economics, Operations Research)
  • Applied machine learning experience in trading or risk (e.g., forecasting, execution analytics, signal research, anomaly detection)
  • Experience with corporate treasury or balance-sheet FX: multi-entity exposure management, hedge programs, and treasury concepts such as liquidity, funding, and cash positioning
  • Experience building risk or decision systems with engineering standards: code review, testing, monitoring, and defined SLAs
  • Experience with distributed data tools (e.g., Spark) and workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Flyte)
  • Prior experience at a growth-stage internet, fintech, or payments company
  • Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs and MBRs
  • A builder's mindset, with a willingness to question assumptions and conventional wisdom
  • Interest in how data products enable automated and agentic workflows, and an understanding that model and data quality determine the reliability of every downstream decision

Director, Engineering, CoinDesk

At CoinDesk, we do more than report on the future of money. We actively help shape it. As the global leader in crypto news, indices, and events, we provide the transparency and context the world needs to understand the digital asset revolution. Our team is dedicated to a shared mission: informing, educating, and connecting the global community.

Our impact is amplified by our position within the Bullish Group. Bullish is a regulated, institutional-grade exchange known for technological prowess. Operating as a subsidiary, CoinDesk is backed by a partner that shares our belief in the transformative power of digital assets.

We value engineers who treat development as a craft. You will own outcomes from concept to deployment. We expect you to navigate the unknown and bring structure to ambiguity. You will help shape the frameworks and processes that drive our global teams forward. We refuse to compromise on quality. We seek problem solvers who thrive on high-impact technical challenges.

The Team: CoinDesk Media Engineering:

The CoinDesk Media Engineering Team builds and optimizes the digital touchpoints that connect millions of global readers to the digital asset economy. Our mission is to ensure seamless, real-time access to breaking journalism, multimedia, and market intelligence for millions of readers worldwide. We are responsible for the architecture, development, and optimization of coindesk.com, the CoinDesk mobile applications, and the high-availability services layer behind both.

What You’ll Do:

  • End-to-End Delivery Excellence: Own features across the complete product lifecycle. You will lead scoping alongside product and design, oversee shipping, and monitor systems in production. You will ensure systems remain secure, fault-tolerant, and performant.
  • Full-Stack Execution: Architect and ship robust functionality across our web platform, mobile applications, and services layer. You will build high-quality solutions using Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, and modern runtime services.
  • AI-Native Engineering: Leverage AI tools as a default part of how you design, build, and optimize software. We use Claude Code, Open Code, and open-source models daily. You will also identify opportunities to build internal tooling that streamlines workflows for editors, designers, and product partners.
  • Direct Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with product managers, UX designers, and editorial stakeholders in a nimble team setting. You will take initiatives from rough conceptual drafts to production reality without unnecessary organizational overhead.
  • Safe Release & Operational Governance: Champion progressive rollout practices using feature flags such as LaunchDarkly. Implement automated CI/CD pipelines and disciplined observability. You will deploy frequently with confidence and minimal blast radius.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Senior-Level Production Experience: 5+ years of shipping production-grade software. You have deep, hands-on authority across modern web architectures (Next.js and React) and backend environments (Node.js and TypeScript). You also have strong experience with RESTful APIs and content management platforms.
  • Web Performance & Architecture Mastery: Advanced expertise in Next.js, server-side rendering (SSR), and modern caching patterns. You demonstrate deep knowledge of Core Web Vitals optimization to deliver lightning-fast experiences for a massive global readership.
  • Quality as a Feature: A fundamental commitment to software quality. You implement rigorous automated testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end suites with Playwright and Maestro. Testing is an inherent part of your development process, not an afterthought.
  • Pragmatic Craftsmanship: A strong bias toward action and simplicity. You thrive in a collaborative environment. You can take existing systems, eliminate technical friction, and make codebases enjoyable and sustainable to scale.
  • End-to-End DevSecOps Mindset: Practical experience managing CI/CD pipelines and embedding security best practices. You have hands-on experience integrating secure identity systems like Auth0 across client and server boundaries.
  • Collaborative Problem Solving: Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with non-engineering stakeholders. You excel at translating product vision into clean, maintainable technical execution.

Nice to Haves:

  • Cross-Platform Mobile Engineering: Hands-on experience building or maintaining mobile apps using React Native and Expo.
  • Publishing & Headless Architecture: Experience with modern headless CMS platforms, such as Sanity, and structured content workflows at scale.
  • Monetization & Analytics Infrastructure: Prior work integrating ad management engines (Google Ad Manager), digital paywalls and billing (Stripe), and behavioral analytics (Amplitude and HubSpot).
  • Cloud Infrastructure & IaC: Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform, including GCP Cloud Functions, and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
  • Modern Runtimes & High-Performance Microservices: Curiosity or hands-on experience with emerging web runtimes like Bun and Elysia, as well as in-memory datastores like Redis.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

In an effort to attract, retain, develop and promote the most qualified individuals, CoinDesk is committed to treating all applicants and employees in a nondiscriminatory manner with respect to the terms and conditions of employment, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status/service, physical or mental disability, or any other classification protected by applicable law. This mandate governs all aspects of employment, including recruitment, selection, promotion, training, education, social and recreation programs, compensation, discipline, termination and access to benefits.

ACCOMMODATION

CoinDesk is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the application process, please send an e-mail to recruiting@coindesk.com and let us know the nature of your request.

Solutions Architect

Our Solutions Architecture team connects business priorities with practical technical solutions, helping customers understand how Chainalysis can support their most important objectives.

In this role, you will provide technical leadership throughout the customer journey. You will turn complex requirements into clear recommendations, help customers envision how our products fit into their operating environment, and guide them toward measurable business outcomes.

As a Solutions Architect, you'll develop a deep understanding of Chainalysis solutions and the problems our customers are trying to solve. You'll explain complex concepts in a clear, compelling way to technical practitioners, business leaders, and executive stakeholders. You'll also build practical, customer-specific solutions that support deployment, integration, adoption, and long-term value.

In this role, you'll:

  • Serve as a core member of the account team, partnering closely with Sales, Services, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering.

  • Take ownership of customer outcomes across the full lifecycle, from initial discovery and solution design through investigation support, compliance program delivery, deployment, enablement, adoption, and expansion.

  • Lead discovery conversations that uncover customer objectives, operational pain points, use cases, technical constraints, and success criteria.

  • Translate business and operational needs into clear technical requirements, solution designs, and implementation paths.

  • Articulate Chainalysis capabilities in a way that is relevant to each customer's compliance, risk, fraud, investigations, or security environment.

  • Create tailored demonstrations, proof-of-value experiences, and technical narratives that show how Chainalysis can address customer priorities.

  • Conduct blockchain investigations, deliver compliance and regulatory guidance, and build technical solutions such as notebooks, dashboards, automation workflows, data integrations, reference architectures, and agentic workflows.

  • Design automation that fits into existing compliance, risk, fraud, investigations, or security operations rather than requiring customers to redesign how they work.

  • Provide guidance on solution architecture, API implementation, workflow design, data movement, and integration considerations.

  • Drive platform adoption by connecting customer workflows to Chainalysis capabilities and identifying new use cases.

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • Several years of experience in one or more relevant areas, such as financial services, compliance, investigations, fraud, cybersecurity, digital assets, transaction monitoring, sales engineering, solutions architecture, or enterprise product management.

  • Experience making complex technical or operational concepts understandable to different audiences.

  • Strong storytelling, presentation, and written communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders.

  • A creative, structured, and investigative approach to solving challenging customer problems.

  • Comfort working with technical tools and learning new technologies quickly. Experience with Python or another programming language, SQL, data analysis, notebooks, workflow automation, APIs, integrations, or AI tools is valuable.

  • The curiosity and initiative to develop technical depth over time; you do not need to arrive with a complete technical stack, but you should enjoy investigating how things work and building the skills to solve new problems.

  • The ability to operate effectively when requirements are ambiguous, information is incomplete, or the best path forward has not yet been defined.

  • A collaborative, generous approach to working with others, including a willingness to share knowledge, seek input, and improve team practices.

  • A demonstrated focus on measurable customer outcomes, not simply technical activity or product usage.

  • An interest in blockchain and a desire to keep building your understanding of the technology, the market, and the customers we serve.

Total Compensation:
• Base Salary Range: $160,000-$185,000
• Offers Commission: 75/25 OTE
• Offers Equity

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

People Programs at Ramp builds the programs that shape how employees experience the company day to day; from someone's first week to the moments that define Ramp's culture company-wide. As Ramp scales, we need someone dedicated to building that function and taking our foundations to the next level.

In this role, you'll own programs like onboarding, manager enablement, engagement surveys, and the company-wide culture and recognition programs that shape how Ramp works, to name a few. You'll work closely with People Business Partners, People Operations, and Comms to make these programs land and thrive.

This work is high impact and high visibility. This is a hands-on, build-from-scratch role for someone with strong judgment who owns things fully.

What You'll Do

  • Build your own roadmap by pulling signal from engagement survey results, PBP and manager input, and People Ops, then make the call on what to build, improve, delegate, or stop.

  • Own onboarding effectiveness — from pre-start through the first week — so every new hire's first experience of Ramp reflects how we work and our culture, partnering with People Ops and IT on day-to-day logistics

  • Own the performance review cycle's program design — timeline, tools, and the manager/employee experience — partnering with PBPs on calibration and outcomes

  • Build and own manager enablement as a standalone program: design the content, frameworks, and moments that help managers lead well, in partnership with PBPs on delivery

  • Conceive, build, and run company-wide culture-building programs, fully owning logistics and content end-to-end

  • Own recognition programming: how we surface and celebrate what's worth celebrating across the company and the rituals/milestones that make Ramp's culture tangible day to day

  • Own the biannual engagement survey: design, run, and work with People Business Partners to translate results into action

  • Be the trusted voice on what we should build in-house versus buy (tools, vendors, platforms) for people programs, grounded in judgment about what's worth the investment, not a default toward either

What You Need

  • 5+ years owning people/culture programs end-to-end at a high-growth company - from ideation through hands-on execution

  • A builder's track record: you've created programming that didn't exist before, not adapted someone else's playbook

  • Strong facilitation and executive presence. You’re comfortable being the face of a program in front of the whole company, not just behind the scenes

  • Comfortable with data: you can read engagement survey results and program metrics and turn them into a point of view, not just a report

  • Proven ability to partner across functions (PBPs, Comms, Enablement, leadership)

  • First-principles thinker who can turn ambiguity into a scalable framework: you don't need a rule book, but you can build one when it's missing

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In two years' time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over one million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.

About the Role

Bitvavo is building dedicated product management for Crypto Custody, the team that keeps customer crypto assets safe and enables earning yield. As Crypto Custody PM Lead, you will own product strategy for our crypto safeguarding and transfer rails, working closely with Engineering (Crypto Safeguarding and Transfers) and Operations to balance security, compliance, growth and revenue.

Employment Setup

This role can be done fully remotely, or based in one of our preferred hubs: Amsterdam, London, Limassol or Vilnius.

What You’ll be Doing

  • Own the product roadmap for crypto wallet security, custody transfers and new asset listings

  • Partner with Engineering to ship hot and cold wallet security improvements

  • Drive the crypto yield roadmap, covering staking, lending, stablecoins and on-chain products, together with Operations

  • Set strategy for withdrawal fees, network fee policy and node infrastructure

  • Manage key vendor relationships, including custodians, validators and infrastructure providers

  • Track AuC growth and yield KPIs in partnership with Data

  • Represent Product in incident response for wallet and crypto rail security events

What We’re Looking For

This role requires crypto experience, gained at a crypto exchange, custody provider or similar crypto native business, combined with experience gained in the European market. We are not able to consider candidates without this background.

  • 8+ years in product management, at least 5 of which should have been gained at a crypto exchange, custody provider or similar crypto native business

  • Relevant experience in the European market is a must-have

  • Strong technical grounding, comfortable discussing wallet security, blockchain fundamentals and infrastructure trade offs with engineers

  • Track record balancing security and compliance requirements with growth and revenue goals

  • Confident managing stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Security and Treasury

  • Solid understanding of crypto fundamentals, with custody experience a strong plus

Desirable

  • Experience with staking, lending or on-chain yield products

  • Experience with crypto custody providers or cold storage operations

  • Background in traditional finance custody or asset servicing

We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. About Groma

Groma is blending real estate and technology to unlock a new real estate asset class while making it easier for everyone – from institutional investors to the residents in our buildings – to participate in ownership. Our property technology platform uses AI to bring new efficiencies to the small unit count multifamily sector, enabling us to efficiently acquire, upgrade, and operate these 2-20 unit multifamily buildings and bring institutional performance to this massive but historically overlooked sector. Our investor technology platform makes owning these assets accessible to a broad array of investors, with bespoke vehicles available to institutional and family office investors and our flagship vehicle, the blockchain-powered GromaREIT, available to everyone, with a special focus on enabling ownership for the residents in our buildings. Visit www.groma.com to learn more about us.

About the Role

We are seeking highly-motivated and organized co-ops to join our property operations team. The Property Operations Co-op will play a crucial role in overseeing the day-to-day operational tasks of our residential real estate portfolio, as well as handle corporate-level administrative responsibilities. This multifaceted role requires a proactive individual with exceptional communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills. The successful candidate will collaborate across various elements of the Property Operations department, including property management, maintenance, construction, and leasing. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Property Management

  • Field inbound calls, emails, and resident portal requests and inquiries
  • Perform on-site property inspections quarterly and for apartment turnovers
  • Perform monthly outstanding balances audit for rent collections
  • Perform monthly billing for completed work orders
  • Collaborate with maintenance on the scheduling and follow-up of maintenance tasks
  • Assist with the move-in and move-out processes

Leasing

  • Execute apartment showings for prospective residents
  • Coordinate  showing requests and third-party real estate agent showings
  • Assist with subletting and lease assignment process for current residents
  • Assist in reviewing rental applications for prospective renters

Corporate Development

  • Assist with the onboarding of new acquisitions to the portfolio
  • Assist with the implementation of policies and procedures across the property operations team
  • Participate in property operations meetings and projects

Experience 

  • 1+ years of experience in customer service or hospitality positions (experience in the real estate, construction, or property management industries is a plus)
  • Strong computer and Excel skills (Google Suite experience preferred)

Team/Role Overview

The GFCO Programs team is the end-to-end DRI for the financial crimes compliance operations experience and automation across Coinbase's global product and entity footprint. We design, govern, and continuously improve compliance operations through AI-first principles, ensuring regulatory soundness, protecting Coinbase, and delivering a better experience for our customers.

We partner deeply with Central Compliance, Compliance Technology, Engineering & Architecture (EAA), GFCO Operations, Analytics, Workforce Management (WFM), Financial Crimes Data Intelligence (FCDI), and Legal to translate regulatory obligations and operational opportunities into scalable, durable programs across all compliance workstreams, products, and jurisdictions — including Suspicious Activity Monitoring (SAM), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), Screening, and Complaints.

As a Senior Strategic Program Lead, GFCO (L5), you will serve as a independent program owner within GFCO Programs — owning one or more complex compliance program verticals end-to-end. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, drive alignment with Director+ stakeholders, and lead programs that span several cross-functional teams, including external parties. You will act as a thought partner to GFCO leadership and be the connective tissue between Compliance Technology, EAA, Operations, WFM, and Central Compliance.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own end-to-end program strategy, planning, and execution for one or more complex GFCO compliance program areas (e.g., SAM/CAR automation, EDD volume reduction, Complaints, Operations, New Jurisdictions & Launches)

  • Author and maintain high-quality strategy and decision documents (P/PSs, RAPIDs, charters) that inform Director/VP-level decision-making
  • Manage the feedback loop between automation outputs, QC findings, alert productivity data, and investigator feedback, driving continuous improvement in both the automation model and upstream alerting systems
  • Lead Code Yellow-equivalent responses within GFCO (e.g., major lookback events, regulatory deadline responses, Sev2 volume surges)

  • Deep understanding of AML/CFT program operations, including SAM/TMS, EDD, Screening, and SAR filing workflows, and the technology landscape that supports them (e.g., TMS, CMS)
